errors.text_span: der dunkelviolette Balken den Wert von 60 Prozent des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten
errors.evidence: In the figure, the legend shows the purple bars correspond to the '60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten'; this is not an error. However, the description says the dark violet bar represents the value of 60 percent of the median wage, which is correct. No error here.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für 2024 und 2025 weisen eine diagonale Streifenmusterung auf, was sie visuell von den vorherigen Jahren unterscheidet.
errors.evidence: Only the 2024 and 2025 purple bars are hatched; the blue bars are not hatched. The sentence is acceptable as written because it refers to the bars for those years in general, but if interpreted as both series it would be imprecise. No clear factual mismatch.
